subject: exp-dym
title: EXP.DYM.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram closing MP(I)-44 — the section on western art music's reserved theatres and the structural absence of black creativity from the New York Times exposure-stream. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the information reality that sustains western art music — whether in America or Europe — is completely isolated from the greater public's view. Instead, the greater public's only involvement with this sector's existence is to see the notice of a given exposure (or performance) in the New York Times. How is it that "Patricia Von Dupotstein" (a name I made up) is given a performance in Alice Tully Hall — when I know NO ONE KNOWS WHO THE HELL SHE IS, let alone where she came from. My point is that all of these matters are political.' The crossing diagrams how expansion-dynamics structurally meets multi-information at the Alice-Tully scale: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). EXP-DYM sits at the right with the subject-arrow; AFI (affinity insight) sits centrally and EXT-FT (extended functionalism) immediately above EXP-DYM as the subject's upper hub. IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) anchors the upper-right and A-PR (all-purpose) at top-center with TRS (transition) above MT-INFO as the partner-side's upper chain. MT-INFO sits at upper-left as partner-axis; CULT-INFO-BS (cultural-information base) hangs at lower-left as the partner's downward output with INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) at the bottom-left as terminus. (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) sits centrally and PART (participation) at the bottom-center as the bridging chain. Structural argument: when expansion-dynamics is crossed with multi-information at the institutional-reception scale, the upper chain TRS → A-PR → IF-ST-DY → EXT-FT → EXP-DYM is the *Patricia Von Dupotstein route* — transition routes through all-purpose into infra-structure dynamics, then through extended-functionalism into the subject's expansion-dynamics. This is exactly how the Alice Tully Hall mechanism works structurally: the institutional reception supplies the upper diagonal through all four edges, so multi-information's output of an unknown performer reaches expansion-dynamics without anyone needing to know who the performer is. MT-INFO → CULT-INFO-BS → INDIV-TD on the lower-left is the partner-side's downward chain — cultural-information-base routes multi-information into individual-tendencies, the partner-side's working. The (R)INTR → PART bridging-chain on the central-bottom is what would be required to let actual public-interpretation reach participation — but in the western-art-music institutional reception the upper diagonal makes the bridging-chain structurally redundant. For black creativity, the upper diagonal does not get held by institutions, so (R)INTR → PART becomes the *only* route — which the public-view-isolation the prose names prevents.
